scope: Selected evidenced properties, not comprehensive v2 qualification. No new requirement imposed on historical authors.

checks.description: Actual delivered grader invoked through a native adapter
Delivered clean runner independently reproduced as documented
Reviewed source requirements preserved in the delivered task
Reviewed graded requirements disclosed to the actual solver
Delivered reference independently checked on core domain obligations
Delivered reference independently checked on licensed boundary cases
Baseline independently qualified correct answer accepted
All exercised qualified baseline faulty controls rejected
Separately authored sibling faulty controls rejected
Author's delivered positive and negative controls execute
Author's own control claims independently validated
Published numeric/calibration claims recomputed from evidence

unknown_policy: Unreviewed, unqualified or originally unrequested properties receive no invented pass or failure; their weight remains unresolved.
scope_policy: Passing D/E checks describes the exercised control bank only. It does not prove an entire language/domain correct.
